    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "lobster_hist_plot <- ggplot(lobster_traps, aes(x = TRAPS)) +\n",
        "  geom_histogram(\n",
        "    bins = 30,\n",
        "    fill = \"steelblue\",\n",
        "    color = \"black\",\n",
        "    alpha = 0.8\n",
        "  ) +\n",
        "  facet_wrap(~ YEAR) +\n",
        "  labs(\n",
        "    title = \"Distribution of Lobster Traps by Year\",\n",
        "    subtitle = \"Histogram of TRAPS values across study years\",\n",
        "    x = \"Number of Traps\",\n",
        "    y = \"Frequency\"\n",
        "  ) +\n",
        "  theme_light() +\n",
        "  theme(\n",
        "    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = \"bold\"),\n",
        "    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),\n",
        "    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),\n",
        "    strip.text = element_text(face = \"bold\"),\n",
        "    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()\n",
        "  )\n",
        "\n",
        "lobster_hist_plot"
      ],

      "source": [

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "lobster_trend_plot <- ggplot(\n",
        "  data = lobsters_traps_summarize,\n",
        "  aes(x = YEAR, y = TOTAL_TRAPS, color = SITE)\n",
        ") +\n",
        "  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +\n",
        "  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +\n",
        "  labs(\n",
        "    title = \"Trend of Commercial Lobster Traps Over Time\",\n",
        "    subtitle = \"Comparison across study sites\",\n",
        "    x = \"Year\",\n",
        "    y = \"Total Number of Traps\",\n",
        "    color = \"Site\"\n",
        "  ) +\n",
        "  scale_x_continuous(\n",
        "    breaks = seq(\n",
        "      min(lobsters_traps_summarize$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE),\n",
        "      max(lobsters_traps_summarize$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE),\n",
        "      by = 1\n",
        "    )\n",
        "  ) +\n",
        "  scale_color_brewer(palette = \"Dark2\") +\n",
        "  theme_light() +\n",
        "  theme(\n",
        "    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = \"bold\"),\n",
        "    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),\n",
        "    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),\n",
        "    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),\n",
        "    legend.title = element_text(face = \"bold\"),\n",
        "    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()\n",
        "  )\n",
        "\n",
        "lobster_trend_plot"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "aes(color = SITE) → maps color to a variable\n",
        "→ each SITE gets a different color,\n",
        "color = \"blue\" outside aes() → sets one fixed color\n",
        "→ all lines same color"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "FR9uBOAc9e-P"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "lobster_traps_fishing_pressure <- lobster_traps %>%\n",
        "    filter(YEAR %in% c(2019, 2020, 2021)) %>%\n",
        "    mutate(FISHING_PRESSURE = if_else(TRAPS >= 8, true = \"high\", false = \"low\")) %>%\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "lobster_pressure_plot <- ggplot(\n",
        "  data = lobster_traps_fishing_pressure,\n",
        "  aes(x = SITE, y = COUNT, fill = FISHING_PRESSURE)\n",
        ") +\n",
        "  geom_col(position = \"dodge\", color = \"black\", alpha = 0.9) +\n",
        "  labs(\n",
        "    title = \"Fishing Pressure Distribution Across Sites\",\n",
        "    subtitle = \"Counts of observations by fishing pressure category\",\n",
        "    x = \"Site\",\n",
        "    y = \"Count\",\n",
        "    fill = \"Fishing Pressure\"\n",
        "  ) +\n",
        "  scale_fill_brewer(palette = \"Set2\") +\n",
        "  theme_light() +\n",
        "  theme(\n",
        "    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = \"bold\"),\n",
        "    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),\n",
